main_body: wooden rocking cradle with canopy/hood on the left and open bed on the right
top_band: On the left hood: rows 3 (1px light tan rim). On the right bed area: rows 6 (inner back wall) and rows 7-8 (2px light blue mattress/blanket surface), followed by row 9 (1px light tan front rail edge). On the left hood interior: rows 4-5 dark shadow, rows 6-8 white/grey pillow.
evidence: The cradle is shown from the side in 3/4 view: you can clearly see into the interior bed (rows 6-8 show the pillow and blue blanket horizontal surface, recessed behind the front rail at row 9), above the vertical wooden side panel (rows 10-12) and curved rockers (rows 13-15). However, the hood on the left (rows 2-8) has only a 1px top edge (row 3) and reads mostly as a flat front/side frame rather than having a foreshortened roof band.

style.evidence: Uses dark brown wood outlines (dark_material_tone) and 5 wood tones plus 3-4 steps on the pillow and blanket. Small 16x16 prop is cleanly shaded and fits the palette and contrast rules well, though slightly simpler in grain than the large reference pieces.
